{{Top|leg}}
The '''Panopticon willow''' was a type of [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that could live well over eight hundred [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]].

The willow had golden optical sensors in each bud of each branch, much like [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], that could interpret the tree's surroundings. These sensors could focus onto a individual targets, and could be shifted by moving its branches. [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitives such as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were able to communicate with the Panopticon willow by touching its bark, which allowed the Jedi to see through the tree's eyes.
